summary: Senior ML engineer with 7 years shipping production ML systems. Led the recommendations stack at MediaCorp from rule-based to deep retrieval — +14% CTR, $4M ARR uplift. PhD in NLP from UB.

experience.description: Lead the recommendations team (4 engineers). Migrated from gradient-boosted ranker to a two-tower retrieval model on PyTorch. Owned A/B platform and offline-eval framework.
Shipped 6 production models for content tagging and abuse detection. Built the offline-eval framework now used by all ML teams.
NLP research on transformer pre-training. Co-authored 2 EMNLP papers.

education.details: Thesis on cross-lingual transfer learning for low-resource languages.
